title: Fix Setup Checklist and Add Proper First-Run Onboarding
goal: Fix the Setup Checklist that can never be fully completed (item 4 requires findings that cannot exist before running a scan), make the entire checklist dismissable, and replace it with a proper first-run onboarding experience.
scope: Three fixes: (1) FIX ITEM 4: Change the Review first finding checklist item to complete as soon as findings exist in ANY completed run for ANY engagement (not only the currently selected run). Query the findings count across all runs for the selected engagement. (2) DISMISS BUTTON: Add a Dismiss button to the Setup Checklist panel that hides it permanently. Store the dismissed state in operator settings (add setup_checklist_dismissed boolean to operator settings, default false). The checklist does not reappear after dismissal. (3) FIRST-RUN ONBOARDING: Replace the Setup Checklist with a clean first-run onboarding banner that only appears when there are zero engagements. Show three cards: (a) Connect ChatGPT OAuth — with link to Settings, checkmark when connected; (b) Create your first engagement — with Start New Mission button; (c) Run your first scan — with instructions. This banner disappears automatically after the first scan completes (first run with status completed). The existing Setup Checklist (with its 4 items) only shows after the first engagement exists and has not been dismissed.
generation_reason: The Setup Checklist is permanently stuck at 3/4 complete because item 4 requires findings that cannot exist before a scan. This creates a persistent visual bug on every Dashboard view.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Checklist fix and onboarding only. No new onboarding wizard or tutorial system.

success_criteria: Item 4 completes when any finding exists for the engagement.
Checklist reaches 4/4 complete when all conditions met.
Dismiss button permanently hides checklist (survives page reload).
First-run onboarding banner shown for zero-engagement installs.
Onboarding banner disappears after first completed scan.

acceptance_criteria: Checklist completable. Dismiss works. First-run banner shown for new installs.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
